messages:
Maria: PR #5123 is up — small allocator tweak to defer frees and reduce GC head-of-line pauses. Would like a quick perf sanity check and approvals so I can merge during today's 16:00 PST merge window.

Kevin: will review in a bit. quick Q: is this changing allocation alignment or just the deferred-free threshold?

Maria: just the deferred-free threshold + a new fastpath for queued frees. no ABI changes. affects hot path under steady allocation.

Nisha: CI perf run looks odd for long sequences — p99 spike. tagging @Jonah for profiler review.

CI-bot: perf-run for PR 5123 completed (longseq, batch=8, seq=2048). Summary:
```
benchmark.longseq.before: p50=42.1ms p99=210.3ms mem=412MB
benchmark.longseq.after:  p50=41.1ms p99=226.1ms mem=424MB
delta: p50 -2.4% | p99 +7.6% | mem +12MB
```

Jonah: saw the profile — GC sweep timing moved slightly. the p99 increase lines up with a background sweep kicking in under long seq workloads (~1.1-1.3s). I can try a quick instrumented run, but initial thought: either tune defer window or gate behind a canary flag.

Kevin: can we run a canary lane (same traffic shape) before merging? if p99 persists we should hold.

Maria: I can add a runtime flag (default off) so we can enable in Canary only. That would let us validate without affecting production. Would that unblock merge for you?

Nisha: +1 for a flag. also can we add a perf guard metric so the flag auto-rollback if p99 reg > 5%?

Kevin: approve conditionally — add the flag and an e2e perf comparison in CI.

Jonah: one nit: docstring on deferred_free.go could be clearer about thread-safety, will comment in PR. otherwise ack.

Maria: pushed a follow-up commit: added `--enable-deferred-free` runtime flag (default false), metric guard for longseq p99, and updated docs. CI triggered new perf run.

CI-bot: e2e comparison uploaded for PR 5123 (canary flag off vs on): longseq p99 delta now +1.2% | mem +8MB. Full report: https://ci.internal/runs/5123/compare

Nisha: +1 — metric delta within SLA and flag gives us control.

Maria: target merge still 16:00 PST. merging in 10 minutes if no objections. :rocket:

Kevin: none from me. :+1:

Jonah: :shipit: (after I push the tiny docstring nitfix — will do immediately)

Maria: merged at 16:05 PST. release note: "allocator: deferred-free optimization behind canary flag `--enable-deferred-free` (default off). mitigates GC pauses in many workloads; enable in canary to validate p99."
